description:
Replace the cargo-ci workspace test step with pinned cargo nextest, adapt reporter parsing and summaries, retain the doctest substep and ignored provenance step, and establish the reporter evidence contract.

## Background

The `test-rust` job and initial nextest policy land in `nextest-foundation`. This task consumes that foundation and owns the first ordered touch of `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` and `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh`; later timing and enforcement tasks modify those files only after this task.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Runs `cargo nextest run --workspace` for the cargo-ci workspace test step and preserves the ignored provenance step.
- [hard] REQ-02: Updates `summarize_pass` and `summarize_fail` for the nextest reporter while preserving the stable summary prefixes recognized by `cargo-ci-selftest.sh`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Keeps `cargo test --doc --workspace` as the separately reported doctest substep.
- [hard] REQ-04: Verifies the nextest reporter success/failure evidence and updates `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` to recognize it without weakening semantic coverage.
- [hard] REQ-05: Fails fast with a clear error when `cargo nextest --version` does not report the pinned 0.9.133, so reporter parsing never runs against an unpinned message format.

## Notes

Ordered overlap: `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` and `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` are first touched here; `step-timing-and-clock` follows this task, and `suite-enforcement` follows that timing task.
title: Swap the cargo-ci suite runner
